messages:
ana_partnerships: Heads-up: reseller onboarding for VoltEdge is blocked on Marketplace (ticket MP-1023456). Procurement says buyer PO is split across reseller (70%) and vendor direct (30%), but marketplace only supports single-settlement. Also VAT/tax jurisdiction mismatch: buyer is EU, vendor is APAC. Can we triage?
josh_salesops: Do we have the marketplace error?
ana_partnerships: Market webhook returns: `422 settlement_mismatch: split_settlement_not_supported`. Buyer legal submitted PO with two lines and two payees.
vendor_ops: From vendor side: their channel contract requires split remittance to both the reseller and their APAC finance arm. They won't accept single settlement.
erin_finance: Split remittance breaks our ledger and recognition. We could try temporary passthrough to vendor for the 30% share, but that requires us to hold and remit VAT differently and triggers reconciliation overhead. Need a numbers/ops plan.
phil_legal: Quick legal flags: if Redwood collects and remits, we need explicit assignment of VAT invoices and a tax representation clause. Also need signature authority from vendor and reseller agreeing to Redwood as the collection intermediary. That's a contract addendum.
marketplace_bot: MP-1023456 update: "Partner Payments reviewing reseller-split options; Marketplace AM engaged."
marc_eng: From engineering: marketplace payload schema doesn't have split payees. We could add passthrough metadata (payee_share array) and a feature flag, but marketplace will still reject unless AM allows an off-platform remittance flow. Dev estimate: 1 dev day + audit logging.
a na_partnerships: (typo correction) ana_partnerships: Proposal: (1) ask vendor/reseller if they can accept single settlement to reseller and have reseller remit to vendor (2) finance to model collect-and-pay flow and reconciliation cost (3) legal to draft narrow addendum assigning VAT invoices and indemnity carveouts (4) eng to estimate schema work as fallback. If marketplace says no, escalate to partnerships leadership for exec exception.
josh_salesops: I'll push reseller to accept single settlement and remit to vendor. Will escalate distributor SLA if needed.
erin_finance: I'll produce a 1-page reconciliation impact and estimated ops cost for temporary Redwood collection. ETA 8 hours.
phil_legal: I'll draft the addendum template (VAT assignment + limited indemnity) and include signatory list. ETA 6 hours.
vendor_ops: We'll ask the APAC finance team if they can accept funds from the reseller instead of direct. Will report back in 24h.
marc_eng: I'll scope the feature flag and logging impact, ETA 10 business hours.
ana_partnerships: Thanks team. If reseller refuses single settlement and marketplace AM denies split, we'll need a decision from partnerships leadership. Keep updates here. :clipboard:
